title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Straw-Raspberry Cherry Ice
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Straw-Raspberry Cherry Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This convenient replacement pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in an irresistible mixed berry and menthol flavour blend. Straw-Raspberry Cherry Ice layers the sweet, ripe taste of Strawberry with fresh, tangy Raspberry and rich Cherry notes, finished with a crisp, cooling Menthol exhale. Together, these flavours create a brisk and fruity vape that's ideal for vapers who enjoy a multi-layered flavour profile bursting with the authentic flavours of summer laced with a refreshing hint of ice. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
